newsitem.title: USA: USG Corp sees solid construction activity.
newsitem.headline: USG Corp sees solid construction activity.

text.p: USG Corp said Monday the building products industry outlook remains positive for the remainder of 1997.

"Consumer confidence and employment growth remain solid," chief executive officer William Foote said in a news release. "These factors suggest that housing activity will continue at good levels. In addition, the remodeling markets are strong, and commercial construction continues to recover. As a result, industry capacity utilization rates are expected to remain high."
The company's business benefitted from favorable market conditions in the United States and Latin America as well as improving conditions in Canada and Europe, Foote said.
The building products company earlier Monday reported net income of $15 million, or $0.15 a share, for the first quarter, compared to a net loss of $15 million, or $0.15 a share, a year ago.
